peasants = {
	can_always_hire = yes
}

laborers = {
	can_always_hire = yes
}

farmers = {
	qualifications = {
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = peasants }
			multiply = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = laborers }
			multiply = 2
		}
	}
}

machinists = {
	qualifications = {
		value = literacy
		multiply = 20
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = laborers }
			multiply = 3
		}
	}
}

clerks = {
	can_always_hire = yes
}
